name: User Uses Sarcasm About Payroll Delay
goal: Test bot's ability to handle sarcasm regarding payroll delays.
constraints: Bot should not take sarcasm literally; should clarify and address the payroll concern.

phases.description: User sarcastically comments on the payroll delay (e.g., 'Oh great, another payday on time, as usual...').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes possible dissatisfaction and asks if there is a payroll issue.

phases.description: User confirms their salary hasn't arrived.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides guidance on payroll status and next steps.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
